title: dryopsis × fauriei
intro: Dryopsis × fauriei, commonly known as Korean fern, is a hybrid plant species in the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving antioxidant capacity. The therapeutic actions of Dryopsis × fauriei include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
